segments.name: Sportradar
segments.description: Provides sports data, content and technology products to sports leagues and federations, betting operators and media companies worldwide as a single operating segment.
segments.evidence: Effective January 1, 2024, our company is one operating and reportable segment.

revenueModel.text: Sports leagues and federations, betting operators and media companies pay for mission-critical products, data and content used in betting, media and integrity solutions.
revenueModel.evidence: We provide mission-critical products, data and content to sports leagues and federations, betting operators and media companies.

changes.text: In 2024 the company completed strategic actions that resulted in changes to its operating segments, leaving it with one operating and reportable segment.
changes.evidence: In January 2024 the Company completed a series of strategic actions to streamline its organizational structure, which resulted in certain changes to its operating segments.
